title: Sulfur Metabolism in Yeast Strains
summary: This cluster revolves around the sulfur metabolism in yeast strains, particularly focusing on the roles of the HSU1 and MET17 genes. The HSU1 gene has various activities, including the production of sulfide and the expression of MET17. MET17, in turn, catalyzes the conversion of sulfate to homocysteine. The cluster also includes various yeast strains, such as S288C and BY4741, and their derivatives, as well as mutants and deletants. The relationships between these entities highlight the importance of sulfur metabolism in yeast growth and survival.
